question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 English paper mein 6 types ke questions aate hain — MCQ (1), Fill Blank (1), Very Short/VSA (1), Short Answer (2), Long Answer (3-5), Essay/Writing (4-5).

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf correct option (a/b/c/d) likhna hota hai. Section A mein passage se, Section D mein chapters se. No explanation needed.
types.mostly_from: Vistas comprehension (Q18), Flamingo passage MCQs (Q10), unseen passage MCQs (Q1/Q2)

types.how_to_attempt: Given options mein se correct word/verb/conjunction choose karke likhna hota hai. Always choose from given brackets.
Direct answer from passage or text. Ek sentence mein khatam karo. For vocabulary: single word answer.
types.mostly_from: Unseen passage comprehension (Q1/Q2), Flamingo/Vistas objective (Q10, Q18)

types.how_to_attempt: 2-3 clear sentences. Direct answer to the question. For synthesis: combine in one sentence as directed.
types.mostly_from: Flamingo Prose (Q12), Flamingo Poetry (Q15), Vistas (Q17), Synthesis (Q8)

types.how_to_attempt: 3 marks = intro point (1) + main explanation with 2-3 supporting points (1.5) + conclusion (0.5). Number your points for clarity.
types.mostly_from: Flamingo Prose any one (Q11), Flamingo Poetry any one (Q14), Vistas any one (Q16)

types.how_to_attempt: Format: (1) Reference — poem name + poet name. (2) Context — kab/kahan yeh lines hain. (3) Explanation — line by line meaning. (4) Special significance — why these lines matter.
types.mostly_from: Any poem from Flamingo — A Thing of Beauty, My Mother at Sixty-Six, Keeping Quiet, etc.

types.how_to_attempt: Always use the correct format. Notice needs: heading, date, body, signature. Letter needs: sender address, date, salutation, body, closing. Report needs: headline, date, byline, body paragraphs.

grammar_syllabus.note: Section C grammar topics (10 marks total).

topics.note: 100 common phrasal verbs yaad karo. Always choose from given brackets — no new phrasal verb likhna.
frequently_asked: broke out / broke through
carry on / carry out
turn on / turn off
broke down / broke up
bring up / bring to
give up / give in
look up / look after
set up / set out

topics.note: Conjunctions ka use context se samjho. Adversative (though, although, but), causal (because, so), conditional (if, unless).
frequently_asked: though / when
unless / so that
so / if
because / although
as soon as / until
either...or / neither...nor
not only...but also

topics.note: Practice combining sentence pairs. Infinitive — 'He has duties to perform.' Participle — 'Jumping, the monkey ran away.'
Teen types clearly samjho. Type 2 mein 'were' use hota hai even for I/he/she.
frequently_asked: If I were the principal... (Type 2 — were, not was)
If India had played well, it would have won... (Type 3)
If you study hard, you will pass... (Type 1)

writing_section_formats.note: Section B writing formats (14 marks total).

formats.structure: School/Organisation name (top centre) | NOTICE (heading — bold, underlined) | Date | Subject/Title | Body — what, when, where, who | Name and Designation of writer
formats.tip: Word limit strict hai. Formal language. No personal pronouns. Box the notice.
frequently_asked_topics: Yuva Mahotsav, cultural events, school activities, awareness programmes

formats.structure: Headline (what happened) | Byline (by [Name], [Designation/Reporter]) | Date and Place | Opening paragraph — the 5 Ws (what, when, where, who, why) | Middle — details of event | Conclusion — outcome/closing remarks
formats.tip: Third person use karo. Past tense. Bullet points allowed in some RBSE papers.
frequently_asked_topics: Career Fair, Annual Function, Tree plantation drive, Debate competition

formats.structure: Topic sentence (first line introduces the topic) | Supporting sentences — 3-4 points with explanation | Concluding sentence
frequently_asked_topics: Hariyalo Rajasthan Abhiyan, Water conservation, Digital India, Yoga Day

formats.structure: Sender's address (top right) | Date | Receiver's address (left) | Subject line | Salutation (Dear Sir/Ma'am) | Body — introduction, main complaint/request, conclusion | Yours faithfully/sincerely | Name and Signature
frequently_asked_topics: Complaint to collector about wine shop near school, noise pollution, road repair
Yoga Teacher application, English Teacher post, any job application

formats.structure: Sender address | Date | Salutation (Dear [Name],) | Body — thank for invite, reason for inability, apology | Yours affectionately/lovingly | Name
frequently_asked_topics: Declining wedding invitation, declining birthday party, unable to attend function

tips: Reading time mein OR options decide karo — dono mat padhna exam time mein
Unseen passage mein answer passage mein se hi likhna hai — apni understanding add karo
Writing section mein format marks bhi milte hain — format bilkul sahi rakho
Section C mein options given hain — bahut carefully choose karo, dono options padhne ke baad
Q10 ka passage carefully padho — 6 marks isme hain aur mostly story ka famous extract hota hai
Q13 stanza explanation mein: Poem ka naam + Poet ka naam likho pehle — 0.5 mark pakka
Q18 Vistas MCQs — 9 marks, no negative marking — sab attempt karo
Letter mein Subject line mat bhoolna — marks katenge
Notice mein date aur designation compulsory hai
Numerals aur facts sahi likhna — MCQs mein close options aate hain

time_allocation.note: Dono unseen passages padho. OR options decide karo Section B + D mein. Q10 ka passage ek baar padho.
Dono passages — direct answers likhte jao. 1 mark each — overthink mat karo.
3 writing questions × ~10-12 min. Format pehle likhna start karo — saves time.
4 grammar questions — choose from given options. Synthesis ka ek sentence banana hai only.
Q10 (6 marks) — 10 min. Q11-Q17 — ~40 min. Q18 MCQs — 10 min.
Word count check karo. Question numbers verify karo. Roll number correctly written hai?
